answer_1.quote: We treat MWP generation as an autoregressive problem … the system has to generate a question starting with the provided seed.
answer_1.outputs: Generated mathematical word problem questions (textual MWPs)

answer_2.quote: Test BLEU and ROUGE (ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2) scores were used as the automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We carried out a human evaluation to validate the quality of the generated questions and the time taken by a tutor to correct a generated MWP.
answer_4.guideline: Tutors edited generated MWPs, recorded the time taken to edit, and identified error types in the questions.
